stock.themeRotation — the answer > one side only, and no theme rotating is a healthy answer
stock.themeRotation — the answer > not held on the server / refused: never "nothing is rotating"
stock.themeRotation — the answer > the sides and the limit are the kind's own (read from the adapter, never retyped)
stock.confluenceBoard — the answer > the board in the server's order, the long-dated share turned into a percent once, and UCT's build time
stock.confluenceBoard — the answer > a direction asked for, a stale board, a missing leg and an unknown build time are each said
stock.confluenceBoard — the answer > nothing on the board is a normal answer; a board still building is never that
stock.confluenceBoard — the answer > the directions and the limit are the kind's own (read from the adapter, never retyped)
stock.expectedMove — the answer > the straddle the server holds, its break-evens, the expiry it runs to, and UCT's own read time
stock.expectedMove — the answer > an expiry on the report day, no report date, and a last good read are each said
stock.expectedMove — the answer > no straddle held: no price is stated, only what was stored; nothing held at all is never "no move is priced"
stock.callSearch — the answer > one line per call with the index's own excerpt, never longer and never as HTML
stock.callSearch — the answer > a search within one stock, a widened search and a total wider than the hits are each said
stock.callSearch — the answer > no hit is a finding about the calls the index holds; an empty index or a failed search is never "no mention"
stock.callSearch — the answer > the query and row limits are the kind's own (read from the adapter, never retyped)

stock.seasonality — the answer > all twelve months by the record's own dates: a thin month flagged, a month nobody counted never 0, the weekdays, the read time beside the data's date
stock.seasonality — the answer > a month the kind sends as 0 with no year counted is still no figure (the count decides, never the number)
stock.seasonality — the answer > an old newest bar is said as stale with both dates; bars before the vendor's first day are said; a missing read time is said
stock.seasonality — the answer > with fewer than two months counted in full there is no highest and no lowest
stock.seasonality — the answer > not held, refused and an unclean answer are never "no pattern", and state no figure
stock.seasonality — the answer > every field the answer reads is the kind's own (read from the adapter, never retyped)
stock.seasonalityBoard — the answer > this month by fund, the best and the weakest sector fund by the panel's own rules, a thin month flagged, a fund with no numbers named with its reason
stock.seasonalityBoard — the answer > the average is the panel's other measure; the best and the weakest stay on the median, as the panel's do
stock.seasonalityBoard — the answer > a whole, settled board says all its funds and has no unfinished line; a fund that failed and one the store does not carry keep their own reasons
stock.seasonalityBoard — the answer > not held, refused, an unclean answer and a board with no numbers are never "no pattern"
stock.seasonalityBoard — the answer > a measure is read by the SEASB panel's own word map, never a second one; the reasons are the kind's own (read from both files)
stock.tideHistory — the answer > the newest sessions by their own dates, the sums the panel offers, what is left out of a session, and that there is no backfill
stock.tideHistory — the answer > a session with no stored row is named as missing, never a zero, and a sum across it is refused in the panel's words
stock.tideHistory — the answer > more missing sessions than the answer names are counted from the kind's own total, the newest named
stock.tideHistory — the answer > a figure the store does not hold is "not given", never $0; one stored session is said as one; an old newest session is stale
stock.tideHistory — the answer > nothing stored, refused and an unclean answer are never "no flow"
stock.tideHistory — the answer > a scope is read by the TIDEH panel's own word map; the scopes, the limits and the row fields are the kind's own (read from both files)
stock.oiChange — the answer > the two log files by their own dates, each side's total, the changed and the new contracts (a new one never a change from 0), and what is left out
stock.oiChange — the answer > a cut list says how many there are and that the small end is cut; one side reads only its own total; a skipped session is said
stock.oiChange — the answer > a stock in neither file is a healthy answer that says so: not a failed read, and not zero open interest
stock.oiChange — the answer > nothing changed is said in words with no table; a side with nothing in both records has no total, never 0
stock.oiChange — the answer > not prepared, refused and an unclean answer are never "no change"
stock.oiChange — the answer > a side is read by the OIC panel's own word map; the sides, their words, the limits and the row fields are the kind's own (read from both files)
stock.treasuryYields — the answer > each maturity by the curve's own date with its changes in basis points, the two spreads in the panel's sentences, and what has no figure
stock.treasuryYields — the answer > an inverted curve and a spread with a missing yield are said in the panel's own sentences
stock.treasuryYields — the answer > a curve that is behind is stale; a look that went badly is said without the vendor's words; a missing read time is said
stock.treasuryYields — the answer > not held, refused and an unclean answer are never "no figure" for a maturity
stock.treasuryYields — the answer > the horizons and every field the answer reads are the kind's own and the RATES panel's own (read from both files)

the drain’s settles > …and the reverse: a record stamped 1 re-queued after an entry stamped 0 keeps 1 (no over-refusal from the entry)
the drain’s settles > settleBlocked, with no record to keep, rebuilds one carrying the ENTRY’s stamp
recovery — the stamp travels with the copy that wins > the durable record alone: its stamp (and none ⇒ none, read as 0 at send)
recovery — the stamp travels with the copy that wins > the crash draft alone: its stamp
recovery — the stamp travels with the copy that wins > a draft AHEAD of the record wins with the DRAFT’s stamp
recovery — the stamp travels with the copy that wins > ⛔ two copies that AGREE ⇒ the LOWER stamp, whichever is listed first
recovery — the stamp travels with the copy that wins > ⛔ adoption carries the LOWER of the record’s and the entry’s stamps
Charts puts the results on the grid, in list order, and back to List restores the list
Next turns the page onto the next results; Prev turns back
the charts-per-page choice is kept, and the view reopens as Charts
the layout menu is the /charts Multi Chart menu: every preset, Custom N×M and the sync toggles, nothing that would replace the results
the sync toggles are kept for the next visit
a member who left on Charts lands on Charts
Map draws the results grouped by sector; a tile opens that stock on the List
the grouping choice is kept; Theme groups by the batched theme read
the controls row shows only on a screen whose starter declares controls
choosing an option edits exactly its clause in the scan, and the Filters count and (edited) mark follow
an option with a sort sets the sort, second key included; the URL keeps it across a refresh
Reset restores the starter spec exactly and forgets the remembered choices of that screen only
a choice is remembered: the preference is written per screen and per control
opening a screen fresh re-applies the remembered choices in ONE scan, shown as the edit they are
a first open that lands on a pinned RS screen applies the remembered choices too
a last-used screen lands at once from this browser, and takes the remembered choices when both reads answer
a member who has already touched the page keeps the screen they landed on
a URL that already carries an edited spec is never overridden by remembered choices
a re-sort from the Sort menu makes Rank by read Custom on the page, with the dot and Reset
back or forward to a spec no starter was made of by its controls alone is a custom screen, without the row
a saved copy of an RS screen is the member's own screen: no quick controls
Top RS Rating has two controls: one inline plus Adjust
List mode never loads ScannerShell; Table mode loads it on demand
only range columns the screen REQUIRES are probed; an any-of alternative is not
a presence probe matches exactly the rows that hold a value
a zero caused by a live-only column with no value yet is "live during the session"
in the session the same zero is an ordinary zero
until every probe answers the reason is unknown, never a guess
Gap Movers after the close is a real zero: its live column is only one alternative
a non-live column nobody holds is "not available yet"
a coverage receipt where no row could be checked is "not available yet"
1. tapping row 2 opens a full-screen dialog named for that stock, with its chart pane
2. Next stock steps to row 3 (pane and list), Previous stock steps back

alert.create > the current price is ONE `quotes` gateway read for the turn; dark → no read, no refusal, the proposal says it was not checked
alert.create > VALID: proposed (never auto-applied); Apply POSTs exactly that alert, reads it back; Undo deletes exactly it
alert.create > UNDO is refused once the alert went off (deleting it would not unsend the notification)

alert.create > UNSUPPORTED condition (not above/below) is refused by the closed schema
alert.create > LIMIT: at most 5 alerts in one request; the same alert twice in one request is refused
alert.create > a DUPLICATE made elsewhere between proposal and Apply is refused at the write (server re-read)
alert.create > PERSISTENCE FAILURE: the server refuses → the receipt says so, nothing is claimed, nothing left behind
alert.create > PARTIAL FAILURE mid-request: the alert already made is taken back
alert.delete > by stable id: proposed; Apply deletes exactly that row and reads back; NO Undo (hard delete)
alert.delete > STALE: the alert went off (or was deleted elsewhere) after the proposal → refused, nothing deleted
alert.delete > an alert that is not in the member's book cannot be targeted

stock.sectorPerformance — the answer > ranks all the funds with the panel helper, strongest and weakest in the text, every fund in the table
stock.sectorPerformance — the answer > says there is no data time instead of stating one
stock.sectorPerformance — the answer > a fund the server could not read is named, never ranked as zero
stock.sectorPerformance — the answer > refused / unavailable: fixed words keyed on the status, no figure, no table
stock.sectorPerformance — the answer > the periods offered are the SCTR panel's own (one list, read from the panel)
stock.analystActions — the answer > names the morning wire by its own date and never calls the list today's
stock.analystActions — the answer > a wire that is behind is said to be stale; an undated list says it cannot be dated
stock.analystActions — the answer > an empty dated list is "none listed"; a failed read is never that
stock.analystActions — the answer > each side the member can ask for is one of the kind's own (read from the adapter, never retyped)
stock.sessionHighsLows — the answer > counts of the session, with the scanner's own polling time and the not-52-week line
stock.sessionHighsLows — the answer > one side only, when asked
stock.sessionHighsLows — the answer > a closed market is the last tracked session, and a stopped scanner is stale
stock.sessionHighsLows — the answer > scanner off / refused: no counts, and never "nothing made a new high"
stock.longRunLeaders — the answer > gainers: the window's move from its reference close, with UCT's own working time
stock.longRunLeaders — the answer > volume records and new listings read their own fields
stock.longRunLeaders — the answer > an empty list says both things it can mean; a list still building is not an empty list
stock.longRunLeaders — the answer > the lists offered are the kind's own (read from the adapter, never retyped)
stock.darkPoolLevels — the answer > levels highest price first, dated by the newest confirmed print (never the build time)
stock.darkPoolLevels — the answer > no cluster is a normal answer; a failed read is never "no levels"
served vs dark > dark (null, data off): none of the five is registered
served vs dark > dark ([], nothing activated): none of the five is registered
served vs dark > dark (["quote","themes","cot.positioning"], other kinds only): none of the five is registered
served vs dark > served sectors.performance alone: only stock.sectorPerformance is registered, once, and it unregisters cleanly
served vs dark > served analyst.actions alone: only stock.analystActions is registered, once, and it unregisters cleanly
served vs dark > served highsLows.session alone: only stock.sessionHighsLows is registered, once, and it unregisters cleanly
served vs dark > served leaders.longRun alone: only stock.longRunLeaders is registered, once, and it unregisters cleanly
served vs dark > served levels.darkpool alone: only stock.darkPoolLevels is registered, once, and it unregisters cleanly
served vs dark > all five served: local-only on BOTH sides for the four isolated kinds, a plain data read for the sector answer
served vs dark > each answer makes ONE read of its own kind, with the member's arguments
served vs dark > no read without a turn or without a usable argument, and a refusal is answered in fixed words
routing words > dark (null, data off): the data group keeps exactly routing.js's words
routing words > dark ([], nothing activated): the data group keeps exactly routing.js's words
routing words > dark (["quote","themes","sectors.performance"], other kinds only): the data group keeps exactly routing.js's words
routing words > served analyst alone: only its own words are added, after routing.js's, and they are taken back
routing words > served highsLows alone: only its own words are added, after routing.js's, and they are taken back
routing words > served leaders alone: only its own words are added, after routing.js's, and they are taken back

which chart > "close the top-left chart": that one and only that one, its neighbours keep their cells, Undo restores it exactly
which chart > "close this chart": the clicked chart, not the first one
which chart > "close the NVDA chart": found by what it shows
which chart > "close the one I just changed": the conversation's subject chart is in the request
which chart > the bottom row of a three-chart board keeps its position words honest after one closes
which chart > a widget that is not there is refused and nothing moves
approval and Undo > two charts in one request are shown first; Dismiss keeps both; Apply closes both; one Undo brings both back
approval and Undo > the only chart on the board closes, and Undo brings its tabs and settings back
approval and Undo > a chart changed after it was closed-and-restored still has a truthful Undo: the member's newer edit is not overwritten

C1-144 Position Calculator: the toolbar's Position tool on ONE chart, through its own state > a long from entry > stop: the selected chart's calculator opens with the three prices; no other chart changes; Undo closes it exactly

C1-144 Position Calculator: the toolbar's Position tool on ONE chart, through its own state > a short from entry < stop; wrong-target control: naming the TSLA chart opens TSLA's calculator, NVDA's (the selected one) stays closed

C1-144 Position Calculator: the toolbar's Position tool on ONE chart, through its own state > refused, nothing opened: a missing price, an unreadable one, a stop at the entry, a target on the losing side, a side that contradicts entry vs stop
C1-144 Position Calculator: the toolbar's Position tool on ONE chart, through its own state > the side is never guessed: positionPlan reads it from entry vs stop only

C1-160 Save as default: the menu row's payload onto ONE chart's drawing defaults > the selected chart's drawingDefaults become exactly what the row saves; the other charts keep theirs; Undo restores the exact blob
